info.title: API.SH: FlixBus
info.description: The FlixBus API from API.SH: public FlixBus data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Cities matching a name, from FlixBus (flixbus.com; FlixBus and Greyhound share one network): `id`, `legacy_id`, `name`, `country`, `region`, `subdivision_code`, `lat`, `lng`, `timezone_offset_seconds`, `has_train_station`, `served`, `score`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-cities

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters of a city name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-city

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Berlin
example.description: Visit iconic landmarks like the Brandenburg Gate and Museum Island; experience vibrant nightlife.

get.description:
Every destination reachable from a city, from FlixBus (flixbus.com; FlixBus and Greyhound share one network): `id`, `name`, `country`, `lat`, `lng`, `price` (`min`, `avg`, `max`, `currency`), `min_duration_minutes`, `avg_duration_minutes`, `transfer_needed`, `transport`, `route_popularity`. Sorted by popularity unless `sort` says otherwise.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-destinations

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Only destinations whose lowest fare is at most this.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A country's most searched FlixBus cities: `id`, `legacy_id`, `name`, `slug`, `country`, `lat`, `lng`, `transport`, `search_volume`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-popular-cities

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every FlixBus departure between two cities or stations on a date, from FlixBus (flixbus.com; FlixBus and Greyhound share one network): `uid`, `status`, `available`, `transfer_type`, `transfers`, `departure` and `arrival` (time with offset, city, station and their ids), `duration_minutes`, `price` (`total`, `original`, `per_person`, the same with the platform fee, `currency`), `seats_left_at_price`, `seats_available`, `bike_slots_available`, `capacity`, `brands`, `operators`, `means_of_transport`, `amenities`, `legs` (ride id, stations, brand, operator, amenities, seat types), `bikes_allowed` and `raw`. Also `stations` and `operators` of the results, `platform_fees` and `no_bikes_period`. `total_unfiltered` counts the trips before the filters. One page holds the whole day.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-search

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Departure city name (e.g. `Berlin`) or a city id from `/flixbus/v1/cities`; with `search_by=stations` a station name or id.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Arrival city or station, as for `from`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: `true`: only trips that can be booked.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest total price in the chosen currency.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stations matching a name, from FlixBus (flixbus.com; FlixBus and Greyhound share one network): `id`, `legacy_id`, `name`, `slug`, `is_train`, `address`, `zip_code`, `city`, `city_id`, `country`, `lat`, `lng`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-stations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters of a station or city name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One trip's itinerary from FlixBus (flixbus.com; FlixBus and Greyhound share one network): every stop with arrival and departure times, the line code and its final destination, brand, carriers, notices, and the departure and arrival stations with address, postcode and coordinates. Give a trip `uid` from `/flixbus/v1/search`, or `from`, `to` and `date`/`days_ahead` to take that day's first departure (`index` picks another). Trip uids expire once the ride has left.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flixbus-trip

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Which departure of that day (0 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
